summary: Lamar Jackson's ankle injury makes a Falcons-led Sunday night script likely, Tampa Bay is without Mayfield and Winfield on Thursday night, and Cincinnati's Chase and Higgins remain in doubt.

NFL|00-0036997|rry.note: Williams is Dallas's clear lead back (19 carries, 5 catches in Week 4) but has not reached 93.5 scrimmage yards lately; with Mayfield out, a lopsided game could add late carries.

NFL|00-0039846|tkl.note: The 5.5 line reflects Antoine Winfield Jr. being ruled out with a rib fracture; Smith now plays nearly every safety snap beside a practice-squad call-up and had 5 and 6 tackles the last two weeks.

NFL|00-0035358|kpts.note: McLaughlin is expected to be fine after a groin/hip listing and is perfect on kicks, but Tampa starts rookie Daniels with Mayfield out and carries an implied total near 18.

NFL|00-0037834|att.note: Purdy has thrown 34, 22, 27 and 30 passes for a 4-0 team with no injury designation; he adds about 10 runs a game, and Pearsall is out for the season.

NFL|00-0038797|rec.note: Wilson is now Seattle's workhorse with Walker gone, Jadarian Price on IR and Charbonnet not activated this week; he caught 3 passes on 24 touches in Week 4, which explains the 1.5 line.

NFL|00-0040730|rry.note: Harvey is Denver's receiving back with 10 catches in Week 4 and 6 in Week 3, while Dobbins handles early downs and rookie Jonah Coleman is on IR.

NFL|00-0036355|ptd.note: Herbert has 4 TDs and 6 INTs for an 0-4 Chargers team, with McConkey (foot) and Alt (neck) day to day; Denver is a 3.5-point road favorite in a low-total game.

NFL|00-0033881|rec.note: Engram caught 1 of 5 targets in Week 4 while Denver's short passes go to Harvey and wideouts Waddle, Sutton and Bryant; no injury news.

NFL|00-0035685|ryd.note: Montgomery's last three games went 6-10, 11-33 and 10-24 while splitting with Woody Marks, who gets goal-line work; a Houston lead could add some late carries.

NFL|00-0040676|pyd.note: Ward is averaging about 181 passing yards with a high of 222 and Saleh keeps backing him; a trailing script as a 7.5-point underdog is the main risk.

NFL|00-0040784|ryd.note: Judkins has no injury and recent lines of 12-21, 18-70 and 17-53; Cleveland has extra rest and no reason for the line rise was found.

NFL|00-0037740|rec.note: With Omar Cooper Jr. on IR, Adonai Mitchell week to week and Breece Hall out, Wilson is the Jets' main target, but Geno Smith completed only 8 passes last week.

NFL|00-0036040|recyd.note: Johnson had 6 catches for 59 yards Monday and has 50 or more in every game as the lead tight end; Jefferson's likely return could push New Orleans into more passing.

NFL|00-0040743|pyd.note: Shough threw for 286 Monday, much of it while trailing in a blowout; Minnesota's pass defense ranks near the top and New Orleans is on a short week.

NFL|00-0035228|pyd.note: Justin Jefferson (ankle) practiced limited and says he will play; Murray threw for 247 in Week 4 even without him, and the Saints just allowed 45 points.

NFL|00-0038128|cmp.note: Willis went 9 of 17 in the Week 4 loss and completes about 57 percent; with Waddle traded and Achane reportedly out, Miami's passing game is thin and no QB change is reported.

NFL|00-0039880|rec.note: With Waddle now in Denver, Washington is Miami's top receiver, leads the team in catches and caught 5 of 5 targets in Week 4, so the 4.5 line reflects a bigger role.

NFL|00-0036442|cmp.note: Ja'Marr Chase (concussion protocol) and Tee Higgins (adductor) are both in doubt with Young and Iosivas also out, and a wide spread could limit late passing.

NFL|00-0033106|att.note: Goff's 52 attempts in Week 4 came while trailing; as a 5.5-point favorite indoors with a 54.5 total, a lead could trim volume even though Lions games have been high scoring.

NFL|00-0039139|rry.note: Gibbs has about 186, 113, 174 and 77 scrimmage yards with Jacob Saylors as the only notable backup, and Detroit is favored against a run defense that allows the 4th-most RB yards.

NFL|00-0037240|rec.note: St. Brown is healthy and LaPorta drew 13 targets in Week 4, leaving Williams third or fourth in line despite his 6-catch game; the high total helps.

NFL|00-0023459|att.note: Pittsburgh passes on about two-thirds of plays and the Colts allow 8.1 yards per attempt; RB Dowdle (toe) and WR Pittman (foot) were limited Wednesday.

NFL|00-0036223|rry.note: Taylor was limited Wednesday for rest only after 95 rushing yards in London; with Keenan Allen limited and other receivers hurt, he may see extra check-downs.

NFL|00-0038542|rry.note: Bijan is off the injury report and Lamar Jackson (ankle) missed Wednesday practice as a long shot to play, favoring an Atlanta lead, though Baltimore allows only 3.9 yards per carry.

NFL|00-0037746|car.note: Robinson has 10 or more carries in three straight games, including 14 against the Saints, and a likely Atlanta lead over a backup QB could add late carries.

NFL|00-0036309|rec.note: Malik Nabers (knee) missed Wednesday practice and Braxton Berrios went to IR, which should push more targets to slot receiver Mooney, who is not on the injury report.

NFL|00-0039409|kpts.note: Jacksonville is about a 4.5-point favorite with a 43.5 total, implying around 24 points; Little made three field goals last week and the Eagles list several starters as questionable.

NFL|00-0038611|car.note: Bhayshul Tuten is Jacksonville's lead back with 17 carries in Week 4, and Rodriguez has had exactly 6 carries in three of four games, so the line matches his role.

NFL|00-0039919|recyd.note: Tyson Bagent starts again with Caleb Williams out; Odunze had 6 catches for 94 yards with Bagent, and both Bears running backs missed Wednesday practice.

NFL|00-0034857|car.note: Allen is off the injury report and has 6, 14, 8 and 5 rushes this season; DJ Moore's Week 4 shoulder injury could add some designed QB runs.
